headline: Spot Taker Buying On OKX Rose To 317.1 BTC From 91.5 BTC
narrative: Aggressive buyers on the OKX bitcoin spot market outpaced sellers by 317.1 BTC over the latest day, up from 91.5 BTC. The pipe measures aggressive buy volume minus aggressive sell volume on OKX spot, a proxy for who is lifting offers, not a cross-venue tape and not passive fills. The 317.1 BTC lead ranks in the 80.2 percentile of 24-hour windows over 30 days, up from the 61.0 percentile.
author: jordan
